messages.subject: Thai Nippon Steel Engineering | Offshore energy, SSHE and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Taishi Takazawa and TNS Leadership Team,

TNS's offshore and onshore engineering portfolio, together with its strong SSHE and sustainability culture, aligns closely with my experience in complex industrial stakeholder environments.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I work across environment, HSE, operations, security, aviation, legal and technical teams while managing regulators, public institutions and communities. My recent work also includes large-scale renewable-energy and carbon-governance initiatives.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across External Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or project stakeholder leadership. I have attached a TNS-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
